complexity.notes: Unnecessarily re-sorts an already sorted input and makes several linear index() calls; a plain two-pointer pass on nums would be O(n) time and O(1) space. The nums2 copy also violates the problem's constant-extra-space requirement, and mutating nums via pop is poor style. Negative-index initialization (high = -1) works but is non-idiomatic.
complexity.summary: Sorts a copy of the array, applies the classic two-pointer scan to find the pair summing to target, then uses index() (plus a pop workaround for duplicate values) to recover the original 1-based indices.
